title: Zero fanout beyond the circuit
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $gs$ and $ext$ be lists of Boolean gates such that every gate in their concatenation reads only vertices with index less than $n+i$, where $i$ is that gate’s position in the concatenation. If $v$ satisfies $n+|gs++ext|\le v$, then no gate in $ext$ reads vertex $v$; equivalently, the fanout of $v$ within $ext$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: The concatenated gate list satisfies the stated acyclicity condition
$v$ is at least $n$ plus the length of the concatenated list
